species.real: Moose are strong swimmers and will dive several metres to graze on water plants.
species.name: Mooslet

dex.text: Gangly, solemn and taller than you already. Wades into the lake for weed and thinks very slowly about everything.
dex.fact: Moose were reintroduced to the Cape Breton Highlands in 1947 and 1948, with animals brought from Alberta, after the old herd had died out.

species.real: A moose can close its nostrils when it dives, which suits a deer that eats pondweed for a living.
species.name: Bullmoose

dex.text: Antlers like a pair of hall tables, and the right of way on every road in Cape Breton. Locals brake for it and so should you.
dex.fact: A bull moose grows a new set of antlers every year and sheds them in winter. Moose are the largest deer in the world and swim well.
